input_validation.unix_type_zero_interpretation: 59 non-directory ZIP entries omit Unix type bits and are modeled as ordinary files; no symlink or other special Unix types are present

layout_model.data_mapping_basis: Proposed flat uv --target model. This archive inventory did not run uv or inspect installer implementation; only data/scripts are present in these exact wheels. Independent installer review must confirm the model before install.
layout_model.directories: union of mapped explicit directory members and all destination parents; excludes target root
layout_model.dist_info: remains under target root; installer may add metadata and regenerate RECORD
layout_model.generated_entry_points: console_scripts and gui_scripts map to target root/bin/<name> on Linux; plugin groups remain metadata
layout_model.no_bytecode_assumption: No compiled .pyc additions modeled. Actual installer bytecode option and environment must be prospectively fixed.

byte_estimate_exclusions: installer metadata additions and RECORD size changes
filesystem inode/directory metadata and allocator behavior
interpreter/stdlib baseline and all external native/runtime resources
limits.rounding_scenario_caveat: Per-file 4096-byte rounding and illustrative 4096 bytes per directory are planning scenarios only; they do not measure tmpfs resident/allocated bytes or give a hard RAM bound.

installer_transformations_to_account_for: Three .data RECORD paths must reflect relocation after installation.
18 generated console wrappers need RECORD entries and previously absent file bytes.
python-louvain bin/community has #!python and requires an installer shebang rewrite; final byte delta depends on exact interpreter path.

Installer metadata such as INSTALLER, direct_url.json, REQUESTED, RECORD rewrites and any bytecode are not included in archive byte or destination-file totals. Exact presence depends on the frozen installer command/configuration.
License files remain inside their owning distribution namespace in this model; no shared top-level license relocation is inferred.

scope.tools: Python standard-library ZIP and distribution metadata parsing only; no archive code import or execution
